name: 书剑天下 2008
english_description: A 2008 build made by the ShuJian MUD development team and hosted by Chongqing Telecom, spanning an unusually large Jin-Yong-flavored map — Shaolin, Wudang, Emei, Kunlun, Mingjiao, the Xingxiu Sect, the Five Mountain sword schools (Hua, Song, Tai, Heng), and the Ancient Tomb, laid over real-world city names from Chang'an to Guangzhou. New characters begin at a martial-arts-hall front courtyard before rolling stats and formally apprenticing into one of these sects. Chinese-name registration explicitly blocks any actual Jin Yong character name (e.g. "萧峰" is rejected outright), and the game runs SMS and VIP subscriber features on top of the usual wuxia stat/sect/cultivation core. Its source is nearly identical to the similarly named sjtx2 (Little Bear branch) elsewhere in this archive — two independent deployments of the same underlying game on different sites.
